manual_requirement.question: Does every Amazon Bedrock agent execution role avoid AWS-managed *FullAccess policies, administrative or privilege-escalation permissions, and have a permissions boundary?
manual_requirement.title: Amazon Bedrock agent execution role follows least privilege
manual_requirement.guidance: Prowler joins GetAgent agentResourceRoleArn with the IAM role inventory and applies its own administrative-access and privilege-escalation combination catalogue to every attached and inline policy. That catalogue is Prowler-specific and not a documented AWS rule; review each agent role's policies and permissions boundary against your least-privilege baseline.

prowler.aws.bedrock_agent_role_least_pri.reason: Rejected as an automatic predicate only: the exact question needs operator judgement or account-wide data outside the per-scope snapshot. Preserved as a manual attestation with source and framework mappings.

manual_requirement.question: Does every Amazon Bedrock agent (draft and every version routed by an active alias) use an execution role that no other agent in the account uses?
manual_requirement.title: Amazon Bedrock agent has a dedicated execution role
manual_requirement.guidance: The source builds an account-wide role index across all regions, agent drafts and alias-routed versions (ListAgentAliases, GetAgentVersion). The per-region snapshot cannot prove dedication account-wide; list agentResourceRoleArn for every agent and deployed version and confirm no role repeats.

manual_requirement.question: Does every CodeBuild project with a GitHub or GitHub Enterprise source (whose service role trusts codebuild.amazonaws.com) build only from a GitHub organization on your approved list?
manual_requirement.title: CodeBuild GitHub sources use approved GitHub organizations
manual_requirement.guidance: Prowler compares the organization segment of the source URL with the operator-supplied codebuild_github_allowed_organizations list (empty by default, so every GitHub project would fail). The approved list is organisation-specific; review each GitHub-sourced project's source.location organization against it.

manual_requirement.question: Are the GitHub/GitLab repositories used as CodeStarSourceConnection sources by CodePipeline pipelines private?
manual_requirement.title: CodePipeline source repositories are private
manual_requirement.guidance: Prowler decides visibility by sending anonymous HTTP requests to github.com and gitlab.com for each FullRepositoryId. PEASO reads only the AWS control plane and makes no requests to third-party sites, so confirm each connection source repository's visibility in the source provider.
